tasks.title: M0 live task acceptance
requirements: Prove one real task travels from an authenticated ChatGPT response through contract parsing, patch application, canonical validation, and a clean committed worktree.
Produce the required durable evidence artifact.
Reuse the durable automation chat; create a fresh chat only when ChatGPT explicitly reports a usage or context limit.
Run the accepted operation with Thinking enabled; verify the desired Thinking state before any usage-gated fresh-chat recovery.
Stop the active response on connection loss, preserve a durable checkpoint, and resume the same operation once after reconnect.

tasks.title: M1 twenty-operation chain
requirements: Execute 20 uniquely marked consecutive browser operations.
Verify exact conversation-signature progression for every operation.
Reach terminal completion with zero duplicate submissions.
